# Don't Get Sick!

> > Evidence-based wellness guidance combining preventive medicine, natural remedies, and metabolic health science to fight chronic illness through lifestyle and nutrition.

Dr. Jesse Santiano's platform provides comprehensive, research-backed health education across metabolic conditions, cardiovascular health, and longevity strategies. The site emphasizes biomarker monitoring, herbal remedies like Jiaogulan tea, and lifestyle interventions supported by clinical studies.

## Core Health Conditions

- [Diabetes](https://drjessesantiano.com/metabolic-health/diabetes): Comprehensive diabetes management guide with Jiaogulan tea and herbal remedies.
- [Hypertension](https://drjessesantiano.com/metabolic-health/hypertension): Hypertension management with natural remedies including hibiscus tea.
- [Atherosclerosis](https://drjessesantiano.com/metabolic-health/atherosclerosis): Atherosclerosis prevention guide with kidney function and biomarker information.
- [Mood Disorders](https://drjessesantiano.com/metabolic-health/mood-disorders): Mood disorders guide covering depression, bipolar disorder, and metabolic links.
- [Dementia](https://drjessesantiano.com/lifestyle-and-longevity/dementia): Dementia prevention strategies using exercise, supplements, and lifestyle changes.

## Lifestyle & Longevity

## Research & Evidence

- [Discover How Coffee And Tea Slash Dementia Risk Now | 2026](https://drjessesantiano.com/discover-coffee-tea-slash-dementia-risk-study): 43-year study on coffee and tea benefits for dementia prevention and brain health.
- [What Exercise Is Best For Knee Arthritis? New 2025 Study Results](https://drjessesantiano.com/what-exercise-is-best-for-knee-arthritis-study): 2025 BMJ study on aerobic exercise effectiveness for knee osteoarthritis relief.
- [New Research Confirms Exercise As A Powerful Tool Against Depression And Anxiety](https://drjessesantiano.com/exercise-powerful-tool-depression-anxiety-new-research): Meta-analysis on exercise effectiveness for depression and anxiety management.
- [Coffee And Tea For Osteoporosis Prevention: A 10-Year Study](https://drjessesantiano.com/coffee-tea-osteoporosis-study-women): 10-year study on coffee and tea effects on bone mineral density in women.
